definition: Illusion — in Kashmir Śaivism, māyā is not the world (as in Advaita) but the power by which Śiva limits himself, creating the appearance of difference and finitude. Māyā is Śiva's own power, not an independent reality.

sources.claim: māyā as Śiva's limiting power, not an independent reality
māyā as the power of contraction (saṃkoca)

translations.note: 'Illusion' is the standard but misleading (implies unreal); better: 'limiting power' or 'contraction' in Trika context.
